answer_raw:
**Florianópolis** offers the most significant stretch for your money, as living costs there are roughly **47% lower than in Lisbon** [3].

| City | Monthly Cost (1 person, with rent) | Rent (Central Apartment) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Florianópolis** | **R$6,365** (as of 2026-09-12) | **R$3,492** (as of 2026-09-12) |
| **Medellín** | **R$9,300** (as of 2026-11-02) | **R$7,370** (as of 2026-11-02) |
| **Lisbon** | **R$12.1K** (as of 2026-11-02) | **R$9,016** (as of 2026-11-02) |

In **Florianópolis**, your $4k (roughly **R$22,000+** depending on current exchange rates) would allow for a very high standard of living, as the monthly cost for one person is **R$6,365** [3]. Rent for a one-bedroom in a good area typically ranges between **R$2,500–R$3,800** [4].

In **Medellín**, the total monthly cost for one person is **R$9,300** [2]. Rent for a central apartment is **R$7,370** [2], making it roughly **23% cheaper** than Lisbon [2].

In **Lisbon**, the monthly cost for one person is **R$12.1K** [2]. Rent for a central apartment is **R$9,016** [2], which is the most expensive option of the three.
